what_slowed_you_down: The global npm install location was not writable, so Monid had to be installed user-locally.
The initially cheapest promotional HeyGen candidate emitted 4:7 output despite 9:16 source photos; it was replaced with Kling 2.5 Turbo I2V, which preserves the 9:16 source framing.
Kling generation and downloads took several minutes overall.
